title: COFF (Common Object File Format) signature
summary: A COFF object file begins with a 20-byte header. The magic number (first 2 bytes) identifies the target machine: 0x014C (i386), 0x8664 (x86-64), 0x01C0 (ARM), 0x01C4 (ARM Thumb), 0xAA64 (ARM64), 0x0200 (IA-64), 0x0166 (MIPS R4000), 0x0520 (RISC-V 32-bit), 0x0560 (RISC-V 64-bit).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: COFF header: Machine (2), NumberOfSections (2), TimeDateStamp (4), PointerToSymbolTable (4), NumberOfSymbols (4), SizeOfOptionalHeader (2), Characteristics (2).
COFF is used by Windows (PE is based on COFF) and some Unix systems.
ELF has largely replaced COFF on Unix-like systems.
